description: Implementation of the ProductReviewService interface, providing business logic for managing product reviews, including fetching reviews by customer or product, and creating new reviews with updated product ratings.

classes.name: ProductReviewServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for product review management, extending generic service features and including methods for creating reviews and retrieving them based on different criteria.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews made by the specified customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for the specified product.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a specific review made by a customer for a product.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new product review, updates product ratings accordingly, and saves the review.
